sources.description: None: its tools cite no workspace.

failed.description: The turn ended in an error.

MrAgentMessage.description: A message of the reviews agent's chat, shaped as Ranger's (its tools as activity); `opens` are the requests whose review it showed, opened by the browser that asked (`request_id`).

session_id.description: The Claude Code session the next question resumes.

queue.description: Questions waiting for the running one, oldest first.

MrAgentSnapshot.description: The reviews agent's chat, as `bridge.mr_reviews.agent.*` gives it.

target.description: The target it is compared with ("origin/main").

unpushed.description: Commits not pushed to its own upstream branch.

below.description: The branch it sits on (an effort's part's base, or a listed branch whose commits it holds): its commits and ahead are its own beyond it.

url.description: Its page on the forge, when it is pushed.

commits.description: Its own commits beyond the target, newest first (at most 50 here).

group.description: The Headed upstream group it is in.

MrBranchInfo.description: A branch headed upstream, as its workspace's checkout has it.

MrDisposition.description: What happens to one commit of an effort.

group.description: Its home: the Workspaces-tree group node, or a workspace's `upstreamWorkspaceHome`.

clone.description: The clone the source is read in.

source.description: An exact ref: refs/remotes/<remote>/<branch> or refs/heads/<branch>.

feeders.description: Exact refs whose commits land into the source.

head.description: The head workspace (its Claude session leads the effort).

MrEffort.description: An upstreaming effort: a large branch (the source) followed commit by commit until all of it is upstream, declared on a group headed upstream or on a workspace headed upstream by itself.

unsorted.description: Commits unsorted now that were not before (new on the source, or put back).

landed.description: Commits upstream now that were not.

inReview.description: Commits in review now that were not.

feeders.description: Feeders whose commits reached the source: how many.

partsMerged.description: Plans whose part is all upstream now.

proposals.description: Commits with proposals to confirm or reject.

upstreamAnyway.description: Said not for upstream, yet upstream.

MrEffortChanges.description: What changed in an effort since the user last looked.

notReady.description: Feeders' commits not on the source yet.

at.description: When the ledger was last derived.

error.description: Read problem (the clone is unreachable, a ref is gone).

overlaps.description: Other efforts or branches holding some of its commits.

proposals.description: Unsorted commits with a fuzzy match to confirm or reject.

changed.description: What changed since the user last looked (What changed).

MrEffortSummary.description: An effort as the inbox shows it: its card.

MrHiddenEntry.description: A request the user removed from the view, for the Restore list.

inference.description: The inference of whose move it is (section 7).

order.description: The user's order (the settings' `order`), when they set one.

orderVersion.description: Counts every change of the order, the pins and the removals: a page keeps what has the higher one.

hidden.description: Removed by the user and quiet since: the "N hidden" list.

panel.description: The search and filter kept across runs and devices.

upstreamWorkspaces.description: The workspaces headed upstream by themselves, outside such a group.

reason.description: A suggestion: why Claude picked it, in one line.

feedback.description: The user's word on a suggestion.

review.description: Its review in Roamgate, once opened.

unavailable.description: A pinned request the forge did not give (not found, no access, host down), or not read yet: the row shows this instead of its state, and only the remove button works.

override.description: What the user (or an agent) set on it by hand.

overrideOutdated.description: The override's whose-move and next step were set before the request moved on (its activity marker changed): shown dimmed, "changed since".

inferred.description: What Roamgate inferred of one's own work (section 7), when it did.

inferredOutdated.description: The inference no longer holds: the request moved on meaningfully since.

lane.description: One's own work: whose move it is (override, inference, else rules).

laneWhy.description: Why it is in its lane, in a few words (the rule, or who set it).

next.description: The next step, and where it comes from.

dependsOn.description: The requests it waits for (keys), override first.

parent.description: Drawn under this request (an open request it depends on, in the list): the key of its parent. Absent for cycles and for dependencies not listed.

unsent.description: A branch the user said will be a request (not proposed yet).

branch.description: A branch headed upstream (no request yet): its key is `branch:<provider>:<host>/<project>@<branch>`, its project the target's.

fromBranch.description: A request opened from a branch headed upstream: that branch.

local.description: Its checkout here: commits not pushed, local changes.

effort.description: The upstreaming effort it is a part of (its name).

merge.description: A merge scheduled by a label, or a bot merging it (section 15).

baseSha.description: The diff's base, when the forge said.

notes.description: Comments by people (not the system's notes).

reasons.description: Why it is the user's: empty for a suggestion.

drafts.description: The user's pending drafts on the forge: GitHub says with the list; GitLab only on a read of the merge request's draft notes.

own.description: The user's own request: where it stands.

dependsOn.description: Request keys it waits for (references found, branch containment, the model).

version.description: The row's version when inferred (head, notes, state, pipeline...).

facts.description: The facts it stood on, to tell a meaningful change (D7).

by.description: model: Claude read it; local: only what was found without a model.

MrInferred.description: What Roamgate inferred of one of the user's own requests or branches: derived (state.json), never synced nor exported. Overrides win over it.

baseSha.description: The diff's base, when the forge said.

notes.description: Comments by people (not the system's notes).

reasons.description: Why it is the user's: empty for a suggestion.

drafts.description: The user's pending drafts on the forge: GitHub says with the list; GitLab only on a read of the merge request's draft notes.

own.description: The user's own request: where it stands.

MrItem.description: One merge or pull request as the inbox lists it.

MrLane.description: The lanes one's own work is grouped in: whose move it is. "done": merged or closed lately.

why.description: What made it close: "same files, subject words, size".

MrMatchProposal.description: An upstream commit proposed as the same change as an effort's commit (D14).

from.description: override: set by hand; rule: from the forge's status.

by.description: For an override: who set it.

MrNextStep.description: The next step on a request, and who said it.

relation.description: same: the same commits; contains: all of one is in the other.

MrOverlap.description: Commits two branches or efforts share (D23).

link.description: A URL, or a path on the workspace that has it (notes, a plan).

marker.description: The request's activity marker when it was set (mrActivityMarker).

MrOverride.description: What the user (or an agent) set by hand on one of their requests: each field set wins over what Roamgate infers. Kept in settings.json (`mr_reviews.overrides`), on every device.

approved.description: Approved as the forge requires (null: the forge did not say).

needsRebase.description: GitLab: the target moved on and it must be rebased to merge.

MrOwnStatus.description: Where one of the user's own requests stands, from the same list query (no call per request): reviews, threads and whether it merges cleanly.

MrPanelState.description: The search and filter the Reviews panel shows, kept across runs and devices (`mr_reviews.panel`): `at` orders the writes, so an older answer never takes a newer search back.

from.description: Made from this existing branch's commit, nothing picked.

ported.description: That branch is a port of the plan: it sits on the part's base, its content its own (not the plan's commits as they are).

base.description: Picked on this part's branch (a plan it depends on or fixes), not the target.

unfolded.description: The fixups its branch still holds as commits (their subjects), as read from it; the plan's other fixups are folded there.

refreshed.description: When the record was last read again from its branch (Refresh part).

conflict.description: The pick stopped here: the commit and its conflicting files; folding when it was the fixups being folded (a rebase), not a pick.

MrPlan.description: A planned request of an effort (D25): commits the leader session proposed (or the user made) to go upstream together. Accepted, it gets its part: a worktree in the effort's group with its commits picked.

MrReason.description: Why a request is the user's: in "To review" (review requested, assigned, mentioned), or in "Mine" (authored by the user).

summary.description: What the agent did, in a few words, for a toast with Undo.

effort.description: An effort's ledger changed: which, and the bulk change Undo takes back.

MrReviewsPush.description: Pushed to every page when what the user authored here changes (the order, pins, removals, overrides...: `{mr_reviews: ...}`): the order itself, so the list follows at once.

hosts.description: Forge hosts whose requests for the user are listed. Empty: the hosts glab and gh are signed in to on the bridge's machine.

followed.description: Projects whose open requests are candidates for suggestions.

checkout.description: When the review worktree follows the selected request.

retentionDays.description: Per-request state is dropped this long after a merge or close.

curation.description: Claude picks suggestions in the background.

inference.description: Claude infers whose move it is and the next step of one's own work.

inferenceHours.description: Hours between two inference runs over what moved (D7).

inferenceModel.description: The model the inference runs on, any name the agent takes; empty: automatic (Sonnet, D27).

suggestDays.description: Only requests updated this many days ago at most are suggested; an older one is considered again once it changes.

hints.description: The user's own hints for the suggestions (areas they maintain, people they work with), in their words; the rest comes from their history.

treeGroups.description: Where each project's review workspace goes in the Workspaces tree: "host/project" -> a path of names (groups, or workspaces). Absent: a "Reviews" group under the clone's workspace, else at the top.

clones.description: Clones picked by the user: "host/project" -> where.

order.description: The inbox in the user's order, as request keys; requests not in it come first, in the inbox's own order. Empty: the inbox's order.

orderVersion.description: Read only: the inbox version, counting every change of what the user authored here (order, pins, removals, overrides...).

pinned.description: Requests the user added by URL, newest first.

hidden.description: Requests the user removed from the view, with their activity marker (mrActivityMarker) at that time: shown again once it changes.

overrides.description: What was set by hand on requests, by request key.

staleDays.description: A request quiet this many days is Stale.

views.description: Saved searches, shown as chips after All / To review / Mine.

upstreamGroups.description: Workspaces-tree groups headed upstream (node ids; nested ones too).

upstreamSkip.description: Workspaces in such a group that are not (the tree's references).

upstreamWorkspaces.description: Workspaces headed upstream by themselves, in no such group (the tree's references; a workspace needs no node of the tree for it).

unsent.description: Branches said to be requests, not proposed yet (D25: "not sent").

efforts.description: Upstreaming efforts, each declared on a group headed upstream.

merge.description: Scheduled merges and merge bots: patterns and names, per scope.

panel.description: The search and filter the panel shows, on every device.

homePrompt.description: The first prompt of a request's home agent ({url} {ref} {title} {author} {target} {source} {project}); empty: DEFAULT_MR_HOME_PROMPT.

reviewWorktrees.description: Read only: each project's review worktree, where it is.

discoveredHosts.description: Read only: the hosts found signed in, when `hosts` is empty.

MrSavedView.description: A saved search: its name and its query (section 5's tokens and words).

MrSection.description: "pinned": added by the user (by URL, or pinned from the list), listed whether or not a query finds it; "mine": to review (requested, assigned, mentioned); "authored": the user's own requests.

state.description: Absent in records from before they were kept: no change said.

MrSeen.description: What the user saw last time they looked.

newCommits.description: The head moved since the user looked.

changed.description: Anything changed since (a new note, a push, a state change).

pipeline.description: The pipeline's status since, when it changed.

unresolved.description: Threads to resolve now, when their number changed.

target.description: Its target branch, when not the default one.

MrUnsent.description: A branch said to be a request before it is one.

MrWhose.description: Whose move it is on one's own request.

MrWorkspaceLink.description: A workspace that is a request's (`bridge.mr_reviews.links`): on its branch, named after it, made as its home ("Start a review with a home"), or its review workspace, on any connection.
